title: Whither Bias Goes, I Will Go: An Integrative, Systematic Review of Algorithmic Bias Mitigation
reasoning: The paper is a systematic review focused on the technical, psychometric, and legal operationalizations of fairness and bias mitigation in the context of personnel selection and machine learning. While it discusses 'justice' and 'fairness' as social concepts, it does not evaluate or benchmark religion, spiritual traditions, or specific moral philosophies.
